claim: Issue #228 step 1 (the last of the Curator's three steps) is measured and landed: the SDT.ACTIVE.AUX.2 family is cleared at the source by not instantiating the masters that carry it. A per-cell measurement at the pin - every leaf cell of the shipped RVT library placed once on a wide-spaced grid, full deck, SDT.ACTIVE.AUX.2 markers attributed by grid position - flags exactly ten masters (AO33x2, OAI22xp33, BUFx4f, CKINVDCx9p33, BUFx4, BUFx2, ICGx5p33DC, ICGx4DC, ICGx6p67DC, ICGx2p67DC, all _ASAP7_75t_R). They are excluded from synthesis with constraints.dont_use in design/synth/slice.synth.json and the CTS buffer moves BUFx4 -> BUFx3 in layout/pnr/slice.pnr.json because BUFx4 is one of the ten; the netlist was re-synthesized, the slice re-routed with the same request geometry and seed, and the column re-assembled. The family goes 594 -> 0 on the slice and 9,504 -> 0 on the column; the routed netlist re-introduces no deviating master (resizer included). The P&R resizer and the re-route move the route-dependent families (M1.S.*, M5.W.3 wiggle; a one-cluster re-appearance of the closed-#4501 off-grid-M4-line-end mode at 4+4 markers on the slice, 64+64 on the column) and the grid families stay recipe-inherent per r6. This record is the committed streams' new measurement of record, replacing r7 (which measured the previous streams byte-identically to r5). Post-route STA at the named corners is re-taken with the new SDF/SPEF/DEF (sta/slice.sta.routed.report.json: setup and hold 0 violations at tt, ss and ff; the pre-route successor record is sta/slice.sta.r7.report.json). Power delivery is not regressed: same recipe over a 1.3% smaller core, segment and via counts recorded before and after below. No waivers, no filters, no rule changes: full 267-id expectation set, packaged deck unmodified. Both committed summary envelopes re-verify klt drc --check: match, exit 0 (this host holds the deck at the recorded absolute path). Layout results against a predictive PDK, not measurements. Not T1 item 3 evidence by itself: the manifest still cites no DRC record and item 3 stays unmet (the remaining families are recorded by name and count with upstream dispositions below).
